summary: Reproduced that Efficient-Large-Model/VILA1.5-3b-AWQ cannot be loaded: its custom llava_llama/LlavaLlamaModel config is unregistered, its only available language-model payload uses a legacy TinyChat int16 qweight/scaled_zeros AWQ layout unsupported by SGLang, and the nominal BF16 safetensor shards referenced by the repository are absent.

tests.what_was_measured: A regression harness reproduced and asserted the current checked-out ModelConfig failure for the checkpoint's unregistered llava_llama model type.
Independently inspected all 739 tensors and asserted the legacy AWQ contract: int16 qweight and scaled_zeros are present while standard qzeros are absent.
The first BF16 shard named by model.safetensors.index.json is absent (HTTP 404); the second shard was checked separately with the same result.
Recorded the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 accelerator without changing device state.

remaining_limitations: No VILA 1.5 model/config implementation is registered in SGLang.
No VILA 1.5 multimodal processor or split-component checkpoint loader is implemented.
The checkpoint's legacy TinyChat AWQ layout is unsupported by SGLang and lacks standard quantization metadata.
The BF16 safetensor shards referenced by the checkpoint index are unavailable from the model repository.
The requested model was not executed and semantic or numerical accuracy was not validated.
The model card does not list AMD GPUs, and no compatible AMD TinyChat path was available on the assigned MI355X.
